title: Logistik Unicorp comprehensive dossier refresh

selectedGap.reason: The owner selected one exact published Logistik Unicorp record for comprehensive review-first enrichment without autonomous acceptance or publication.

guardrailNotes: This is one bounded refresh of the existing published Logistik Unicorp record and creates no duplicate organization.
Contract ceilings, disclosed base values, amendments and contribution amounts retain their distinct public bases and are not represented as expenditure or delivery.
The candidate remains pending for human Admin Review and cannot approve, publish or directly change the canonical atlas.

candidates.reviewerRationale: Coverage value: Logistik Unicorp can update current activity to the 2026-07-30 CW2397900 amendment and add the Women's Armour System, DICE, OCFC2 and connected-PPE records. Evidence: 16 durable sources from Logistik Unicorp, CanadaBuys, National Defence, Open Government, NP Aerospace, BodyArmorNews and Wynnchurch support the proposed fields. Mission/Public Need read: No new Mission Area or Public Need match is proposed; entitlement-based ordering, secure warehousing and distribution remain the bounded operating premise. Unknowns: Amendment 004 scope, complete Women's Armour System adoption, item-level manufacturing and current equity percentages remain unverified. Reviewer action: Review the current activity update, the C$41,780,930.95 DICE value, child capability and program records, and the C$75,000 funding event before leaving the consolidated refresh pending.
reviewWarnings: CanadaBuys does not disclose what equipment, quantity or service amendment 004 adds, and no reviewed official source confirms DICE delivery, acceptance or fielding.
NP Aerospace calls the joint Women's Armour System field-ready, but no reviewed durable source identifies a buyer, contract, delivery, acceptance or in-service deployment for the complete system.
Logistik reports a hybrid factory, supplier and commercial sourcing model; public sources do not identify the manufacturer of every item delivered under its managed programs.
Wynnchurch still lists Logistik as a portfolio company, but current equity percentages and ultimate beneficial ownership are not publicly disclosed.
NRC IRAP agreement 1038022 establishes a C$75,000 feasibility proof of concept, not a successful technical outcome, product readiness, customer or deployment.
DND's C$19.7 million initial DICE value excluding tax and CanadaBuys' C$24,224,260.49 base-page value have different unexplained public bases and are not combined.
